title: Prawn and courgette linguine with broad bean salad
description: This simple summery courgette and prawn pasta dish by Gennaro is a quick dinner for when you don't want to slave away in a hot kitchen. The courgettes cook down into a creamy sauce that's flavoured with garlic and anchovy. Get ahead by making the salad early.

steps.text: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta according to the packet instructions or until al dente.
steps.raw: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta according to the packet instructions or until al dente.

steps.text: Meanwhile, take handfuls of the grated courgette, squeeze out the excess water and set aside to drain on kitchen paper.
steps.raw: Meanwhile, take handfuls of the grated courgette, squeeze out the excess water and set aside to drain on kitchen paper.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a low–medium heat. Add the garlic and anchovy fillets and gently fry for a minute, or until the anchovies have disintegrated. Add the courgette and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes, or until softened.
